translation: The Shoutai bone (壽臺骨) is the mastoid process (完骨), behind the ear, connecting to the Yulou bone (玉樓骨) of the ear. If injured by a fall or blow, the upper and lower parts of the ear both swell up, and if the forbidden bone (禁骨) within the ear is injured, then blood, pus, and water appear; outside the ear, stasis accumulates and congeals with pain, and the sinews knot and cannot relax and open, so that there is dizziness and blurred vision, distending pain of the two temples and Fusang bones (扶桑骨), stiffness of the neck sinews, deficient floating red-purple, scanty spirit, weakness of the four limbs, restlessness in sitting and lying, and little eating and drinking. Apply Wu Long Ointment (烏龍膏) to the injured place of the ear, wrap Dao Qi Tong Yu Ding (導氣通瘀錠) in silk floss and insert it into the ear; internally take Ren Shen Zi Jin Dan (人參紫金丹) to free stasis and disperse swelling; externally use Ba Xian Xiao Yao Tang (八仙逍遙湯) to fumigate and wash, dispersing the deficient floating swelling and pain.
